rationale: This contact sheet does not yet read as a 20-option portfolio with at least ten materially distinct three-dimensional families. It is dominated by a compact orthogonal bar/block language with repeated voiding, notching, and stepped roof variants. The strongest distinctions are only mildly legible at sheet scale, so the dominant family share is too high and the program-specific spatial language remains weak. The set needs more variation in section and access relations—courtyard, split wing, bridge, lifted base, corner carve, and terrace—while preserving the required active ground edge and calm upper massing for 근린생활시설.

repeated_family_groups.shared_language: Most options stay within orthogonal bar/block/chunk masses with minor notches, lifts, or voids; the portfolio reads as one family of compact extrusions rather than distinct spatial logics.
Shared block/slab footprint with a central or near-central subtraction; the mass remains a box with a court-like cut rather than a different section type.
Repeated voided roof/upper subtraction language; the roofline variations are too slight to separate families at contact-sheet scale.
Entry-notch slab family with a bent or winged extension; these read as close variants of the same bent-bar/slab chassis.
Lifted-threshold / stepped upper mass family with a compact footprint and a single public cut; both rely on similar section relief.

required_next_relations: Add at least 3 clearly different void/section families: one true courtyard cut-through, one split-wing or bridge-over-void, and one carved corner/terrace section.
Introduce at least 2 non-box dominant readings that are still compact: bent-bar with open end, cross-mass with offset arms, or attach-volume with a displaced secondary volume.
Keep the active street edge explicit in every new candidate: widened threshold, recessed base, or lifted corner that clearly addresses the west access side.
Avoid repeating the same central court, roof notch, or stepped cap as the main differentiator; vary the section relation, not just the silhouette outline.
Target families that read as different access-to-void logics: pass-through, undercroft, side court, roof terrace, and split mass with bridge connection.
